description: Read the active schematic page compactly. what: 'summary' (counts, designators, net names of wires), 'parts' (components with pin coordinates), 'wires', 'snapshot' (parts+flags+wires), 'nets' (whole-schematic netlist {net: pins}), 'net' (one net by name or by pin like 'U1.3', needs `net`), 'check' (floating pins, single-pin nets, unnumbered or duplicate designators, EasyEDA's own rule check counts), 'overlaps' (parts, labels and wires lying on each other), 'free' (room for a block of `size` [w,h]: rectangles touching nothing), 'boxes' (the rectangle every object takes). Filter with `des` (designators) or `region` [x1,y1,x2,y2]. Pin x,y is the outer end where a wire attaches.

count.description: what:'free': how many places to return (default 1).

net.description: Net name (wires, net) or a pin like U1.3 (net).

size.description: what:'free': [width, height] of the block to fit.

name: sch_read
